parent_objective: execute no-training fresh/generalization benchmark for raw scaling candidates
blocked_by: raw candidates have public proof retention but no fresh/generalization benchmark evidence

public_gates: benchmark seeds 9705 and 9706 over 256 episodes each
include M568, alpha_0_1 candidates, raw candidates, heuristic, and random
raw clearance delta >= +0.002 over combined fresh benchmark
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train actor or residual parameters
do not change benchmark thresholds after seeing results
do not treat this public fresh benchmark as a private holdout

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_generalization: test raw scaling usefulness on fresh public diagnostic distribution
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: executes the M899 no-training fresh benchmark and seed-delta audit
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: fresh public diagnostic only; no training, PPO, public-base integration, private holdout claim, or promotion
stop_condition: stop if either benchmark run fails to sample scenarios
stop if raw success or termination regresses beyond tolerance
stop if raw clearance effect is below threshold and no seed-level benefit exists
stop if PPO or promotion is attempted
fallback_plan: if sampling fails, route to sampling/config audit
if behavior regresses, route to behavior-regression audit
if raw effect is weak, route to richer/fresher corpus design
if raw effect is useful, route to fresh-result audit before integration design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M899 admits no-training fresh benchmark execution

hypothesis: Raw candidates will retain success/termination and show larger clearance movement than alpha_0_1 on a fresh public diagnostic distribution.
success_criteria: M900 keeps PPO and promotion blocked
failure_criteria: raw candidates regress success or termination beyond tolerance
raw clearance delta is below +0.002 and seed deltas show no useful events
